channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran reinstates some internet access but restrictions remain for most
item.description: Not all data centres are back online while internet protocols remain blocked, restricted or 'whitelisted'.

item.title: What are the chances for the Iran-US ‘Declaration of Principles’?
item.description: Analysts Negar Mortazavi and Colin Clarke dissect the complications surrounding the Iran-US deal.

item.title: Israeli airstrikes devastate Lebanon’s Tyre
item.description: Video from southern Lebanon shows widespread destruction after Israel repeatedly bombed the city of Tyre.

item.title: Rio’s Forever War
item.description: In 2025, Brazil’s deadliest police raid killed 120 people and exposed a pattern of mishandled evidence and impunity.

item.title: Ukrainian drone attacks hit multiple Russian targets, including refinery
item.description: Saratov refinery hit as Ukrainian strikes intensify across Russian regions, damaging civilian infrastructure.

item.title: Trump tightens terms on Iran war deal, US media say
item.description: US officials indicate Tehran may take days to respond to Trump's tougher terms on a potential peace agreement.

item.title: The strait may reopen, but global confidence may not return
item.description: The next phase of the Strait of Hormuz crisis may be defined less by its closure than by conditional access.

item.title: Israel seizes castle in Lebanon as it expands ground offensive
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu describes the capture of the strategic fortress as a "decisive shift" in its military campaign against Hezbollah.
